cards.rules_text: Run this Command on a compatible component on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.

cards.rules_text: Run this Command on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.

cards.rules_text: Run this Command on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.

cards.rules_text: Run this Command on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.
cards.educational_text: An assigned address does not prove that the gateway, name service, or remote destination is reachable.

cards.rules_text: Run this Command on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.

cards.rules_text: Run this Command on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.

cards.rules_text: Run this Command on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on a compatible component on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.

presentation.short_description: Checks whether a documented, de-energized electrical path conducts between specified endpoints, revealing an open or unintended connection.

presentation.short_description: Compares firmware boot, hardware, clock, and management settings with the approved baseline to identify reset or unintended configuration changes.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.
cards.educational_text: Record current values before changing them; defaults and setting names vary by platform and firmware release.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on a compatible component on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.
cards.educational_text: Newest is not automatically safest; use the platform dependency order, release notes, and recovery plan.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.

presentation.short_description: Checks accessible hardware for loose seating, damaged connectors, blocked airflow, contamination, and other visible conditions that can explain the reported symptom.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.
cards.educational_text: De-energize and apply electrostatic-discharge controls whenever the platform service procedure requires internal access.

presentation.short_description: Determines whether the baseboard management controller (BMC) is reachable, resettable, in recovery mode, or unrecoverable.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on a compatible component on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.
cards.educational_text: Test reachability and approved recovery paths before treating the entire system board as failed.

presentation.short_description: Preserves current management logs, refreshes controller state, and checks whether the target alert returns under the complaint conditions.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.
cards.educational_text: Follow the platform population rules and restore the original configuration after the comparison.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.

presentation.short_description: Replaces the current Ethernet cable with a verified compatible cable and compares carrier, error counters, and reachability to isolate the cable from the adapter or switch port.

cards.educational_text: Keep the adapter and switch-port configuration unchanged during the comparison.

presentation.short_description: Inspects free-address capacity, active leases, exclusions, and stale reservations on the Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) service.

cards.educational_text: Record scope utilization and the specific allocation state; do not delete active reservations merely because the pool is full.

presentation.short_description: Interprets a Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) client exchange to distinguish an absent server offer from client-side address-configuration problems.

cards.educational_text: Preserve the exact Discover, Offer, Request, acknowledgement, timeout, and server-identity observations.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.
cards.educational_text: A correct address and route do not prove physical link or application-level service; test those layers separately.

presentation.short_description: Observes Ethernet carrier, negotiated speed and duplex, indicators, and link errors to determine whether the physical link is present and stable.

presentation.short_description: Compares enumerated Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe) devices, identifiers, and link information with the expected hardware inventory to find a missing or unexpected adapter.

cards.educational_text: Enumeration proves that a device is visible, not that its driver and full function are healthy.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on a compatible component on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.
cards.educational_text: Hot-swap support and redundancy requirements vary by platform; follow the approved power-supply procedure.

cards.educational_text: Do not generalize an Advanced Technology Extended (ATX) pinout to a proprietary or hot-swap server interface; use model-specific documentation and electrical-safety controls.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.
cards.educational_text: Indicator meanings and sensor thresholds are platform-specific; correlate them with the exact model documentation.

cards.educational_text: Visibility at one layer does not prove end-to-end path health; preserve bay and serial mapping across every view.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.
cards.educational_text: Vendor attributes and thresholds vary; protect data before destructive testing, firmware work, or replacement.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on a compatible component on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.
cards.educational_text: Capture the device serial, bay, controller log, and health data before replacement. Avoid destructive tests before data protection.

presentation.short_description: Reads redundant array of independent disks (RAID) controller, array, member, redundancy, rebuild, and error state to distinguish a failed member, degraded array, or controller-visibility problem.

cards.educational_text: Preserve controller metadata and the serial-to-bay map before replacing or moving any array member.

presentation.short_description: Correlates timestamped baseboard management controller (BMC) event-log and sensor entries with the complaint to identify affected hardware and recurrence.

cards.educational_text: Check controller time, event age, and repeated entries; a historical alert may not describe the current machine state.

cards.educational_text: Define stop limits and protect production data before loading the system; stop immediately at unsafe temperature or instability.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.
cards.educational_text: Brief or location-specific dropouts can disappear in an instantaneous reading; correlate telemetry with observation over time.

presentation.short_description: Observes processor and platform temperature sensors at idle and under a controlled load, revealing trends, limit crossings, and thermal-shutdown conditions.

cards.rules_text: Run this Test on the displayed Ticket. Add its diagnostic finding to the work record; it remains available on the Diagnostic Bench.
cards.educational_text: Sensor locations, limits, and control behavior vary by platform; compare readings with the approved thermal specification.

cards.rules_text: Use after the team accepts an Isolation that this procedure can repair. Discard after use; Verify is still required.
